Some proteins are probably paired with the wrong DNA: make the names match (or put both files in the same order) and run again.

summary_text: 1 sequence of 6 was written to the output but is probably wrong (first: g2: Paired with DNA 'other2' only by its position in the files: check that this is the right DNA.) Remove it before analysis, or use --strict to refuse such genes.
methods_text: Codon alignments were built with COAL v0.5.0 (https://github.com/plumat-coal/COAL), which places each coding DNA sequence onto the protein multiple sequence alignment codon by codon (the method of PAL2NAL; Suyama et al. 2006), using the standard genetic code (NCBI translation table 1). Of 6 sequences, 4 matched their protein exactly; 1 were paired with their DNA only by their order in the files; and 1 was written to the output but flagged as probably wrong (most likely the wrong DNA, a shifted position or the wrong genetic code); remove it before analysis. Command: coal pep.fasta nuc.fasta -o out.fa
